content.text:
I'm checking whether the diagonal shape encloses any hole—tracing its cells to see if they form a diamond around an empty center.

Testing with 4-connectivity, the cell at (1,7) is surrounded on all four sides by 3-colored cells, confirming it's fully enclosed. So the answer is 3.
